# Shubham Kumar Gupta

> Software engineer building AI systems and full-stack products. Current work includes HUNT, Staffly, Chakra47, agent evaluation and inference infrastructure. Based in Noida, India. B.Tech in Computer Science, AI & ML, at Amity University Noida; expected July 2027.

Updated: 8 October 2026. Project status and verification dates below distinguish current products, development work and research.

Contact: kshubham04907@gmail.com · https://linkedin.com/in/shubhamgupta04907 · https://github.com/kshubham090 · https://x.com/skg_curious

## Products and applications

- [HUNT](https://www.shubham.cv/projects/hunt) — Early-access B2B accounts-receivable product. TypeScript/React, Node.js/Fastify, PostgreSQL and Azure OpenAI. Invoice creation, editing and issuance, reviewed CSV/XLSX/PDF imports, payment allocations, scoped access and human approval controls. Site: https://www.gogethunt.com. The public demo at https://demo.gogethunt.com uses fictional records and scripted conversations. Accepted into Microsoft for Startups, NVIDIA Inception and Sarvam's Startup Program.
- [Staffly](https://www.shubham.cv/projects/staffly) — Live staffing and workforce-management MVP with public onboarding and an isolated demo. AI-assisted, human-led requests, reviewed offers, shifts, reported hours and approval documents. Next.js/React/TypeScript, Supabase/PostgreSQL and Azure OpenAI. Payroll processing and legally issued invoices are outside the current MVP scope. Site: https://staffly-navy-psi.vercel.app.
- [Chakra47](https://www.shubham.cv/projects/chakra47) — Apps for the physical world. An application and management layer in development above Linux, RTOS environments and robot controllers. Current product and architecture work does not establish a shipped operating system or hardware deployment. Site: https://chakra47.com.
- [FlexFit Studio](https://www.shubham.cv/projects/flexfit-studio) — Full-stack gym-management prototype: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, tRPC, Drizzle and SQLite. Bookings, memberships, transactional cancellations, credit refunds and waitlists; 14 related tables and 76 Vitest tests across 12 files in the inspected repository.
- [Stakrid Logistics](https://www.shubham.cv/projects/stakrid) — Built and operated January 2025–January 2026. 40+ Spring Boot REST endpoints and GCP infrastructure. Workflow automation reduced manual processing by 80%; query optimization and connection pooling reduced API latency from 800 ms to under 200 ms.

## Agent systems

- [Lowq X1 — Agent Eval Harness](https://www.shubham.cv/projects/lowq-x1-agent-eval-harness) — Output and tool-trajectory scoring, Codex/Claude Code/Python/CLI/HTTP adapters, dataset and scoring-protocol regression gates, and repeated-run statistics. Verification snapshot, 4 October 2026: 407 tests passed on Linux, with CI across Linux, macOS and Windows. Offline adapter protocol tests do not establish authenticated live Codex or Claude Code benchmark results. Repository: https://github.com/kshubham090/Agent-Eval-Harness.
- [Lowq X2 — Contextual LLM Gateway](https://www.shubham.cv/projects/lowq-x2-contextual-llm-gateway) — FastAPI, scoped PostgreSQL/Neo4j context, exact caching, transactional outbox delivery, circuit breakers and Prometheus metrics. Verification snapshot, 4 October 2026: 158 tests including nine service integration tests. Optional CPU/CUDA/MPS inference backends. A three-trial MiniLM experiment measured 8.36x higher warm embedding throughput on Apple MPS at batch size 32 versus 1; this is not an end-to-end or CUDA speedup. Repository: https://github.com/kshubham090/contextual-llm-gateway.
- [Relogged](https://www.shubham.cv/projects/relogged) — Recorded tool-call replay and checkpoint-based debugging for LangGraph. Reading stored traces does not invoke live models or tools; fork replay resumes later steps live. Repository: https://github.com/kshubham090/relogged.

## Research

- [Auditing Evaluation Leakage in Formula 1 Race-Strategy Machine Learning](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21862868) — Zenodo preprint, August 2026. XGBoost experiments on 20,447 laps across 22 races, grouped validation, baseline comparisons and a 6,133-lap next-season holdout. The audit examines split design and target-derived inputs; a reported R² alone does not establish leakage-free predictive performance. Historical article: https://www.shubham.cv/research/f1-lap-time-pitstop-prediction. Historical PDF: https://www.shubham.cv/research/f1-lap-time-pitstop-prediction.pdf.
- [VAYAS: Age-Stratified Audit of Hindi Speech Recognition](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22176362) — Co-authored Zenodo preprint, August 2026. Four ASR systems, 50 older speakers and matched controls, WER/CER analysis, bootstrap uncertainty and multiple-testing correction. Observed age effects did not remain significant after correction.
- Vyaskosh — Model training and benchmarking continue in the broader research project; a second manuscript is in progress.
- [AgenticSwarm](https://www.shubham.cv/projects/chakra47-agentic-swarm) — Earlier governed multi-agent research using custom Python orchestration, policy checks and a SHA-256 audit chain. Related Chakra47 research was presented as Symbiote-X at the India AI Impact Summit 2026. This prototype is separate from the newer Chakra47 application-layer direction. Repository: https://github.com/kshubham090/Chakra47-AgenticSwarm.
